newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil citrus firm Rhamo to build Santos terminal.
newsitem.headline: Brazil citrus firm Rhamo to build Santos terminal.

text.p: Sao Paulo citrus firm Rhamo Comercial Ltda has signed a 20-year lease for a plot at Santos port where it plans to build an export terminal capable of storing 22,000 tonnes frozen orange juice, the port said.

The new terminal, to be built in an area of 8,000 square metres, will cost around 11 million reais ($10.3 million) and is expected to start operating in December, according to Rhamo director Rogerio Carvalho Braga.

The company aims to export 130,000 tonnes of frozen concentrated orange juice annually to the European Union, he said. Work on a cold chamber containing 20 tanks of 1,100 tonnes each is expected to start this month.
